platformAccountManagement.scope: platform-super-admin organization, local user and fixed platform administrator create, read, edit, status, membership, role, session and forced-password management with novice labels
platformAccountManagement.truthBoundary: only MySQL account and non-secret session metadata; no password hashes, session tokens, IP or user-agent hashes or credentials; organization creation grants the selected first administrator an organization data scope; adding an existing user requires an active verified account and atomically creates one membership, exactly one organization role and one organization-wide data scope while accepting a matching unexpired invitation without changing platform roles; disable and forced-password operations revoke active user_sessions; granting a platform role to an existing account preserves an enabled MFA factor or marks enrollment mandatory before business access; the live gate compares all persisted platform role capabilities with the fixed code catalog and records every allowed and denied decision
platformAccountManagement.permission: platform:superadmin plus same-origin Origin, Idempotency-Key and audited reason for writes; the live MySQL gate assigns each fixed platform role to an isolated account, exercises every capability through AuthorizationService, and verifies authorization_decisions before cleanup
platformAccountManagement.persistence: platform_account_operations idempotency plus existing organizations, workspaces, memberships, fixed role assignments, membership_data_scopes and platform_audit_events
platformAccountManagement.organizationWizard: the platform create-organization dialog separates organization identity from first-administrator selection and impact confirmation; it validates the 2-63 character lowercase ASCII slug with a browser-valid pattern before continuing, keeps API failure guidance inside the open wizard for correction and retry, submits the unchanged atomic name, slug and optional initial_admin_user_id contract only after final confirmation, then opens the created organization detail
platformAccountManagement.roleComparison: platform super administrators compare any two active platform roles from the server-owned roles and role_capabilities catalog; the UI defaults to differences only, uses Chinese capability labels, and never infers authorization from visible buttons
platformAccountManagement.responsiveAccountView: desktop account lists use tables while narrow screens use summary cards, record detail drawers and a state-preserving filter drawer; organization, user and administrator list actions all enter their detail view, existing verified users can be added to one active organization with one explicit role from the user detail, account status, session, password and platform-role operations stay inside the relevant detail, and raw organization or user UUIDs appear only inside technical details
platformAccountManagement.frontendModuleBoundary: PlatformAccountCenter owns API filters audited writes dialogs and tab orchestration; PlatformOrganizationRecords owns organization list presentation, PlatformUserRecords owns ordinary-user list presentation, PlatformAdminRecords owns administrator list presentation, and PlatformRoleComparison owns server-provided capability comparison without duplicating permission decisions
platformAccountManagement.frontendRefreshBoundary: the account overview loads organization and user facts independently from the administrator-only role catalog; role-catalog failure cannot clear account facts, duplicate refresh is coalesced, a failed refresh preserves the last successful facts, and a 12-second browser timeout exposes an explicit retry state; organization-name and ASCII-slug filtering share an explicit utf8mb4 comparison boundary so Chinese queries remain valid on MySQL 5.7
platformAccountManagement.organizationListBoundary: the organization route uses organization-only search and status labels; desktop and mobile filtered-empty states retain a direct clear-filter action while list, create and detail routes continue to use the unchanged account API and Vue Router history
platformAccountManagement.modalAccessibility: account-management dialogs use the native modal top layer, trap focus, close with Escape and restore focus to the invoking control; opaque dialog surfaces and backdrops prevent underlying content from bleeding through
platformAccountManagement.navigationBoundary: platform, organization-admin and member shells have distinct primary menus; infrastructure pages are removed from the novice platform primary navigation but protected historical routes remain
